learning_outcomes.text: The student who completes the course successfully will be able to demonstrate a basic knowledge of the main issues related to the architecture, protocols and applications of the Internet.

At the end of the course the student will be able to understand the working principles of Internet, will know the main protocols of the TCP/IP stack and will be able to use wireshark for network traffic analysis.
The student will be able to understand the mode of operation of the main protocols and network devices.

syllabus_topics: The fundamental elements of the Internet
Delay and loss in packet-switched networks
Protocol layers and their service models
TCP mechanisms for flow and congestion control
teaching_methods: face to face lectures with the use of slides
lab classes with traffic and protocol analysis using wireshark

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination with questions on various parts of the course and traffic trace analysis

assessment_rules: The exam will consist of an oral examination. A basic knowledge of the different topics is required to pass the exam. The final mark will depend on the level of understanding and in-depth study shown by the student during the oral exam.
bibliography: James F. Kurose, Keith W. Ross, "Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach",Pearson Addison-Wesley
Web site of the reference book
Recording of the lessons of the a.y. 2022/23
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Delle Telecomunicazioni (Telecommunications Engineering), classe L-8 R Ingegneria dell'informazione
